llm_summary: Microsoft confirmed that its global outage, which lasted several hours and affected a range of services, is now fully resolved. The company said it is actively monitoring the backlog of email messages that piled up during the disruption before declaring the issue completely cleared. Users can expect normal operation of both consumer and enterprise services moving forward.
